slides.title: CHAPTER 1 · Each Section Is a Web Page

units.en: Each section of the video is a web page.
units.zh: 视频的每一段都是一个网页。

units.en: Circles, lines, labels, and subtitles | are placed on it, just like on a slide.
units.zh: 圆、线、标签和字幕 | 都摆在上面，就像一页幻灯片。

units.en: Ask the page for any moment, say 12.5 seconds,
units.zh: 随便问网页一个时间点，比如 12.5 秒，

units.en: and it draws exactly what should be on screen.
units.zh: 它就画出那一刻屏幕上该有的画面。

units.en: The same time always gives the same picture.
units.zh: 同一个时间，永远得到同一张画面。

source_text: Each section of the video is a web page. Circles, lines, labels, and subtitles are placed on it, just like on a slide. Ask the page for any moment, say 12.5 seconds, and it draws exactly what should be on screen. The same time always gives the same picture.
